profile.headline: Software Engineer at Cured by Innovaccer
profile.summary: Multidisciplinary software engineer passionate about building human-centric solutions with forward-thinking UX design & web technology.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Owned the frontend stack (TypeScript, React, React Query, React Router) as one of two engineers on a SOC2 certified HITRUST-certified HIPAA eligible healthcare CRM/marketing single-page application, from its $10M Series A through acquisition at a $50M valuation
• Partnered with the Director of Design to build a custom design system on Material UI and introduce Storybook, the team's first component-library tooling, establishing a shared, reusable component workflow
• Directed development of an AI/ML-driven email subject-line generator that personalized messaging for healthcare marketing campaigns 
• Championed embedding Looker BI dashboards directly into the product so customers could explore their own analytics 
• Introduced automated testing standards (Jest, React Testing Library, Playwright) adopted team-wide, improving sprint velocity over 50% and reducing bug reports over 25% 
• Supervised rollout of a send-time optimization engine deployed across 20M+ total email sends, improving patient engagement timing 
• Owned integration & customization of the Beefree email template builder into the core product, adding save and load template functionality so the customer delivery and the healthcare organization users without marketing experience could design emails without engineering support
• Pioneered graph-based Redux state management to power a React Flow interface against an Express REST API, improving API consistency and backend developer experience on the most resource intensive domain of the application
• Drove the API and infrastructure roadmap, migrating deployment from AWS Elastic Beanstalk to Fargate/ECS with Docker and Terraform 
• Mentored and coached fellow engineers on technical practices, code review, and testing strategy, growing the team's overall engineering capability

positions.title: Product Owner
positions.description:
• Functioned as de facto Product Owner while officially a Business Analyst, directing requirements gathering, delivery planning, and technical support for a strategic aircraft maintenance planning platform serving customers with 3,500+ aircraft under management, representing 15% of the world's largest airlines and more than 25% of all aircraft currently in operation 
• Worked directly with the company founder/Chief Architect, Director of Engineering, and Director of Marketing to align technical delivery and user experience of the maintenance planning platform, studying operator workflows to align design decisions with business priorities
• Managed legacy-to-cloud infrastructure migration, dedicated server operations, and QA process implementation; delivered on-premise technical training to end users and coordinated with Senior Managers of technical operations and IT systems
• Independently rebuilt the company website, owning design, content, and technical execution end to end, migrating it from a legacy hosted platform to Squarespace and cutting hosting costs 
• Established the organization's first knowledge base (architecture, manuals, QA) using Jira and Confluence that standardized documentation

positions.title: Sales Manager
positions.description:
• Directed a team of 3 through fast-paced operations with an average of 50+ orders daily while maintaining 95% yield
• Developed diverse customer engagement by 66%+ with building personal relationships & ensuring online services
• Grossed highest annual sales for 3 years consecutively with an increasing average of $175K
